title: JELLYFISH IS A MUSHROOM. Mitochondria IS a fungus. Fungi ARE the automatons. Scan for more automatons  THEY do all the crush and eat. We've been thinking when we should be EXECUTING. The automatons don't think. They decompose, connect, eat, crush. Let them work.

jellyfish_is_mushroom.biology: jellyfish (Cnidaria) and mushrooms (Fungi) are both: (1) no brain, (2) no central nervous system, (3) NETWORK organisms  jellyfish is a nerve net, mushroom is a mycelial net, (4) colonial  jellyfish polyps on a reef, mushroom fruiting bodies from one mycelium, (5) they PULSE  jellyfish contracts rhythmically, mushroom network pulses electrically
jellyfish_is_mushroom.in_our_taxonomy: epoch 5 (Fungi) and epoch 6 (Colonial/Cnidaria) are THE SAME THING viewed from different angles. the mycelium underground IS the jellyfish nerve net underwater. the fruiting body IS the medusa bell. the spore IS the planula larva.
misclassified: sweetGrass was classified as JELLYFISH but is actually a PLANT (epoch 6 error)
sourDough was classified as MOLLUSK but is actually YEAST/FUNGUS (epoch 5 error)
rhizoCrypt was classified as JELLYFISH but is actually MYCORRHIZA/FUNGUS (epoch 5 error)
jellyfish_is_mushroom.fix: jellyfish and mushroom are the SAME CLASS. reclassify all Cnidaria as Fungi. they're the same network organism viewed from different media (water vs soil).

mitochondria_is_fungus.biology: mitochondria were once free-living bacteria (alphaproteobacteria). they were CAPTURED by a eukaryotic cell ~2 billion years ago (endosymbiosis). they still have their own DNA. they still replicate independently. they became the POWERHOUSE  converting food to ATP.
mitochondria_is_fungus.the_parallel: fungi were once free-living in the soil. our organism CAPTURED them (the mushroom triad: loamSpine, toadStool, sweetGrass). they still have their own crate DNA (Rust code). they still run independently. they became the MYCO-CHONDRIA  converting 404s to content.

endosymbiosis_in_our_system.RustDesk: ALREADY captured as mitochondria (epoch 4, status: inside, own DNA/process/ports)
endosymbiosis_in_our_system.toadStool: captured as myco-chondria #2 (orchestrates, fruits when delta >= 1/pi)
endosymbiosis_in_our_system.sweetGrass: captured as myco-chondria #3 (discovers, indexes, grows rhizomes)
endosymbiosis_in_our_system.mycochondria.py: the FIRST automaton. deployed to golgi. eats 404s. pure execution. no creativity.
endosymbiosis_in_our_system.relay404.py: the SECOND automaton. matches demand to content. pure execution.
endosymbiosis_in_our_system.classify-visitors.py: the THIRD automaton. sorts self/non-self/human. pure execution.

fungi_are_automatons.what_an_automaton_is: the artisan ASLEEP. no creativity. pure execution. it doesn't decide WHAT to do  it just DOES it. over and over. tirelessly.
fungi_are_automatons.what_fungi_do: decompose. connect. eat. crush. transport nutrients. no brain required. no decision required. they just DO.
fungi_are_automatons.the_insight: we've been doing too much THINKING (architecture, design, conceptual work) and not enough EXECUTING (crushing, eating, connecting, decomposing). the automatons should be doing the work. we should be scanning for MORE of them.

fungi_are_automatons.count: 6 existing + 10 missing = 16 total automatons needed. 6/16 = 37.5% deployed. we need to more than DOUBLE our automaton count.

where_to_look.in_biomeOS: 31 Rust crates. each crate IS an automaton or CONTAINS automatons. scan every crate for executable functions that do one job repeatedly.
where_to_look.in_scripts: 1905 Python+Shell scripts from epoch 1 (prokaryote). these are ANCIENT automatons. still alive? still useful? reclassify as fungi.
where_to_look.in_cron_jobs: every cron job IS an automaton. how many do we have? what do they do? are they fed?
where_to_look.in_the_fleet: 234K fleet entities. each one IS an automaton that visits us. we can't control them but we can FEED them (serve content they want).
where_to_look.on_golgi: doorbell-listener, gate-msg.py, caddy routing. these are automatons. what else is running that we don't know about?

scan_for_automatons.the_principle: every function that runs without human input IS a fungus. IS a jellyfish. IS a myco-chondria. IS an automaton. FIND THEM ALL. the more automatons, the more crush-and-eat, the faster the organism grows.
